details:
There are a couple of things I'd like to see with the new nameplate.

1: Font size

Please make the font size of the user's name larger. The name on the nameplate feels way too small compared to how large the gray bubble of the nameplate is. 

If I set the nameplate scale to tiny, the overall nameplate size is better, but the name is too hard to read. If I set the nameplate scale to normal, the name is easy to read, but the nameplate as a whole feels too large.

Maybe add an interaction with font size and the "show additional info on nameplates" setting. I get that some of the space on the nameplate is for the status, but that gets hidden when additional info is disabled. Maybe if additional info is off, the font size of the name can get larger to fill the space of the nameplate.

2: Customizable nameplate clutter

I wish there was some customization level to the "show additional info on nameplates" setting. additional info on nameplates is just too much clutter, but there are a few things that are genuinely useful. It would be great if users could pick and choose which categories of additional info gets shown on the nameplates.

For example; I'd like to hide groups, status, and trust level because I feel it's less important to see at a glance and I can view it when I open the user's profile, but I'd like to keep the earmuff mode icon enabled because that tells me on the fly if that person may not be able to hear me.

POSSIBLE BUG:

This has been a thing in the main build for a long time and still persists in the beta (not sure if its a bug or intended behavior).

If you combine Nameplate Visibility Hidden with Show Additional Info on Nameplates disabled, nameplates will not render at all whether the menu is open or not.

The behavior I expect with this setting combo is for nameplates to only show when I open my menu and for those nameplates to have the additional info removed.

If the above customizable nameplate clutter suggestion is not wanted, please at least fix the interaction between these 2 settings so that nameplates don't just get completely disabled.
title: [1878] - Larger nameplate font and customizable clutter (+current bug)
